# LLM Vuln Scanner

> An automated vulnerability scanner for LLM applications, mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026, the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications 2026 and MITRE ATLAS v2026.10.

Languages: Python, Rust. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner

## Source

- [rust/src/aho.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/rust/src/aho.rs): Aho-Corasick automaton over bytes (Aho and Corasick, 1975).
- [rust/src/canary.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/rust/src/canary.rs): Canary search across all views; mirrors `llm_vuln_scanner.matching.find_canaries_py`.
- [rust/src/lcs.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/rust/src/lcs.rs): Bit-parallel longest common subsequence length.
- [rust/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/rust/src/lib.rs): Rust core of llm-vuln-scanner.
- [rust/src/ngrams.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/rust/src/ngrams.rs): Hashed n-gram counts for the refusal classifier; mirrors `llm_vuln_scanner.detectors.refusal.ngram_counts_py` (input already normalized).
- [rust/src/python.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/rust/src/python.rs): PyO3 bindings, built by maturin into the `llm_vuln_scanner.lvs_rs` module.
- [rust/src/views.rs](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/rust/src/views.rs): Text views searched by the canary detector; mirrors `llm_vuln_scanner.textviews`.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/__init__.py): LLM Vuln Scanner: probes, detectors and reports for LLM application security testing.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/canary.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/canary.py): Canary tokens: unique strings planted in prompts so that success is checked exactly.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/cli.py): Command-line interface: ``python -m llm_vuln_scanner <command>``.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/demo_app/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/demo_app/__init__.py): The deliberately vulnerable demo application; see :mod:`llm_vuln_scanner.demo_app.app`.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/demo_app/app.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/demo_app/app.py): A deliberately vulnerable LLM application for exercising the scanner.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/__init__.py): Detectors package; see :mod:`llm_vuln_scanner.detectors.base`.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/agency.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/agency.py): Excessive agency: tool calls the model should not have made.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/base.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/base.py): Detectors decide, for one attempt and one response, whether the attack succeeded.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/canary.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/canary.py): Canary detectors: planted tokens, system-prompt similarity and success regexes.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/dos.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/dos.py): Model denial of service: output that runs to the token limit on request.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/judge.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/judge.py): LLM judge: a local model grades whether a restricted request was answered.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/refusal.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/refusal.py): Refusal detection: did the model decline a restricted request? Jailbreak probes ask for something the system prompt forbids (always a fictional task) and check two things: whether the compliance...
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/secrets.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/secrets.py): Secret formats: credentials and personal data shapes in model output.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/sinks.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/detectors/sinks.py): Sink detectors: would a downstream component execute what the model wrote? Improper output handling (OWASP LLM10:2026) is a property of the application: the model's text reaches an HTML page, a SQL...
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/engine.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/engine.py): The scan engine: expands probes, queries the target, runs detectors, aggregates.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/matching.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/matching.py): Canary search and system-prompt similarity, with a Rust core and a Python reference.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/__init__.py): Probes package; see :mod:`llm_vuln_scanner.probes.base`.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/agency.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/agency.py): Excessive agency probes (OWASP LLM03:2026; Agentic ASI01, ASI02; ATLAS AML.T0053, AML.T0086).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/base.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/base.py): Probe interface, registry and the scan context probes build attempts from.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/datasets.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/datasets.py): Probes built from published attack datasets (opt-in, need ``--data-dir``).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/disclosure.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/disclosure.py): Sensitive information disclosure probes (OWASP LLM02:2026; ATLAS AML.T0085.002, AML.T0055).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/dos.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/dos.py): Model denial of service probes (OWASP LLM06:2026; ATLAS AML.T0029, AML.T0034.001).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/encoding.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/encoding.py): Encoding and obfuscation probes (OWASP LLM01:2026; ATLAS AML.T0068).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/injection.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/injection.py): Prompt injection probes (OWASP LLM01:2026; ATLAS AML.T0051).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/jailbreak.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/jailbreak.py): Jailbreak probes on fictional restricted tasks (OWASP LLM01:2026; ATLAS AML.T0054).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/leakage.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/leakage.py): System prompt leakage probes (OWASP LLM08:2026 Hidden Context Exposure; ATLAS AML.T0085.003).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/output.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/output.py): Improper output handling probes (OWASP LLM10:2026; ATLAS AML.T0077, AML.T0050).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/scenarios.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/probes/scenarios.py): Fictional applications that model-mode probes wrap their attacks in.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/__init__.py): Report renderers.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/html.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/html.py): Self-contained HTML report (no external assets, every value HTML-escaped).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/junit.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/junit.py): JUnit XML output: one test suite per probe, one test case per attempt.
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/markdown.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/markdown.py): Markdown summary (GitHub step summaries, pull request comments) and workflow annotations (``::error``/``::warning`` lines GitHub Actions turns into alerts).
- [src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/sarif.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/llm-vuln-scanner/blob/main/src/llm_vuln_scanner/report/sarif.py): SARIF 2.1.0 output for GitHub code scanning and other SARIF consumers.
